text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/2026-03-gpu-surge). We need to lock owners, timelines, and a short remediation checklist for GPU capacity + autoscale stuff. I pulled the action items into this thread so we can confirm owners and due dates.

simon: I can own scheduler tuning experiments. Plan: run binpacking + soft preemption experiments on a canary pool, measure pod eviction rate and tail latency. Target: Thu EOD for initial numbers.

irene: I'll take quota requests with cloud. Filing the formal quota ticket now and looping in finance for budget sign-off. Expect a response from cloud quota team by Mon.

alex: I'll own headroom policy proposal. My current thinking: target 8-12% spare GPU headroom to keep p95 latency under SLO during surges. I'll run simulations and produce cost delta. ETA Fri.

devon: I'll analyze recurring incident patterns (last 90 days) and produce a histogram + service-owner hitlist. Need access to the query logs and scheduler metrics — tagging @eng-sre for any access blockers.

ops-bot: Note: created ticket INC-9832 for quota request by irene. Linked to postmortem doc.

maya: Thanks. For clarity, here's the short action list I want confirmed by EOD tomorrow:
- quota request (owner: irene) -> ticket filed, cloud response ETA Mon
- scheduler tuning (owner: simon) -> experiment + canary -> Thu EOD
- headroom policy (owner: alex) -> write proposal + cost sim -> Fri
- incident-pattern analysis (owner: devon) -> 90d heatmap + repeat offender services -> Tue
- alert thresholds (owner: priya) -> propose and roll alerts -> Fri
- emergency manual scale runbook update (owner: maya) -> add steps + contact list -> Wed

simon: Quick config I'm going to test (will iterate):
```
scheduler:
  binpack: true
  preemption: soft
  headroom_percent: 10
  burst_scale_threshold: 0.25  # fraction of spare capacity to trigger burst
```
I'll share the experiment script and perf numbers in this thread.

irene: Quota update: request submitted (cloud ticket #QC-4419). I included expected steady-state + surge headroom numbers and a justification doc. Pinging finance for pre-approval.

devon: I pulled logs and ran an initial pass. Early signal: three services (search-ingest, batch-embeddings, live-chat) accounted for ~70% of GPU surge spikes. Will produce a CSV of spike timestamps and corresponding queues.

priya: On alerts: propose we alert when free_gpus < 5 for >5m, and a second alert when scheduling_latency_p95 > 2s for >3m. If everyone OK I'll own the rollout (PagerDuty + Console dashboards).

maya: Agree on those thresholds as a starting point. Priya, please also add a runbook step to escalate to ops on the first alert.

alex: Headroom sim note: if we set 10% spare headroom across all pools, cost delta is roughly +6% infra spend but p95 latency improves ~18% under the test workload. I'll add sensitivity runs with 5% and 15%.

devon: Putting a recurring query in Grafana to surface top offending services each day; will link dashboard here.

simon: Rollout plan for scheduler changes: 1) canary pool (5% of capacity), 2) monitor eviction + latency for 24h, 3) broaden to 25% if stable, 4) full rollout. If any metric regresses >10% we rollback.

maya: Good. One more: please add a short checklist into the incident playbook doc (Operations > Playbooks > GPU capacity) with these owners and dates. I want a single place to track closure.

priya: Will add alerts + playbook snippet. Targeting Friday for both.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly ops sync scheduled Thu 15:00 UTC. Added a short agenda item for GPU capacity remediation.

alex: I'll include cost-per-hour estimates and expected SLA impact in the playbook entry.

devon: Timeline summary (for tracking):
- Mon: cloud quota response expected
- Tue: incident pattern report done
- Thu: scheduler canary results + weekly ops sync update
- Fri: headroom proposal + alerts rolled out

maya: Thanks all. If there are blockers (access, finance, cloud limits) call them out here asap. I'll follow up in the weekly ops sync and tick off items as they close. :thumbsup:

simon: ack. planning a short explainer doc for the tuning changes and will paste commands for the canary.

irene: tagging finance: @finance-team please watch for QC-4419.

devon: uploading CSV to the doc repo and will paste link here when done.

maya: Closing loop — will post a short status update each day until all items are closed. Thanks everyone.
